title: Croatian Frittata with Taleggio
description: A creamy and savory Croatian-inspired frittata filled with melted Taleggio cheese, perfect for a comforting breakfast or brunch.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the Croatian sausage over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon, until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced potatoes and chopped onions to the skillet and cook until the potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the eggs and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the cooked sausage and potato mixture to the bowl and stir to combine.
Pour the egg mixture into a greased 9-inch (23cm) pie plate or skillet.
Top with sliced Taleggio cheese and chopped parsley.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the cheese is melted and golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
